user.title: Add AI早知道播客
user.description: Fetch the daily episode of a 小宇宙 podcast and play it to a media player.

data.music_when_empty: Play music when no new episode

data_description.podcast: Full xiaoyuzhoufm podcast URL or the 24-character podcast ID used to fetch the latest episode.
data_description.title_prefix: Episode prefix; the latest episode is matched by "<prefix>-YY-MM-DD", e.g. "AI早知道".
data_description.media_player: Where the podcast is played. Skipped with a notice when unavailable/unknown.
data_description.notify_service: Optional, e.g. notify.wework. Used for "no new episode", playback failures and continue-music results. Empty = HA persistent notification only.
data_description.notify_target: Optional target/recipient passed to the notify service.
data_description.volume: Set the speaker volume (0-1) before playing; 0 = leave the current volume untouched.
data_description.ringtone_enabled: Play a short ringtone before the episode (built-in morning ringtone, original speed, fade-out, volume untouched). Requires ffmpeg in the container.
data_description.ringtone_file: Optional absolute path inside the HA container, e.g. /config/local/my-ring.mp3. Empty = built-in ringtone.
data_description.speed: Episode speed 0.5-3.0, default 1.0. The ringtone always plays at original speed.
data_description.base_url: Address the player uses to reach HA, e.g. http://192.168.101.75. Empty = auto-detect (HA internal/external URL, then network IP). Recommended when ringtone or speed is enabled because audio is served from /local/.
data_description.continue_music: After the podcast finishes (>= 80% played), ask Music Assistant to play random tracks from the library. Requires the MA integration.
data_description.continue_tracks: How many random tracks to queue; 1 = a single track. Shared by continue-after-playback and no-episode mode.
data_description.continue_player: Music Assistant player used for continued music and no-episode mode. Defaults to the podcast player. For an ESPHome speaker, MA usually exposes it under the same name with a _2 suffix.
data_description.music_when_empty: When there is no new episode today, play random music instead of only notifying. Uses the track count and player below.
